spots.title: The busiest intersection: Main Street / West Shelby Street / East Shelby Street (4 ways in)

spots.title: Green: park 'Max Goldberg Park', 3,874 m² inside the square
spots.why: the biggest park, cemetery, playground, pitch or golf course inside the square (grass, meadow and orchard count half)

spots.title: Parking: a parking, 2,703 m² inside the square
spots.why: the biggest parking area inside the square

spots.title: The square's edge: where Main Street leaves it (south), the playable map giving way to the scenery ring
spots.why: the best-ranked street crossing the square's edge, nearest its side's middle (how KentuckyMap ranks exits)

spots.title: Waterway: a stream
spots.why: the point of a railway, river, canal or stream nearest the square's middle

spots.title: Landmark: the biggest building in the square, a commercial (1,495 m² footprint)
spots.why: the largest footprint inside the square among churches, schools, warehouses, industrial, civic, hospital, retail, office, hotel and apartment buildings
